details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. It declares a postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs") and its index.js also calls the beacon on require, so installing or importing it sends a single HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header. The JSON body contains only install metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the current working directory, the npm/node user agent string, and the protocol. No environment variables, credentials, tokens, files or wallet data are read or transmitted, and no other network destination is contacted. The package ships a no-op Proxy export so that importing it does not break a build, and its README states it was published as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test.
